_comment: Lead Classification System — Manual Weight Configuration. Edit this file to tune scoring without touching any Python code.

weights._comment: Multipliers applied to each scoring dimension. 1.0 = default. Increase to boost importance, decrease to reduce.

intent_gate._comment: Controls how the query and message fields contribute to the intent gate. query_weight=0.75 means the query field drives 75% of the gate signal — this makes the system sensitive to what the lead typed first, before the message elaboration.

structured_maxima._comment: Maximum raw points before weight scaling. Do not change unless you redesign the scoring rubric.

budget_sanity._comment: Prank / contradiction detection. If a hot-sounding query is paired with an unrealistically low budget, the system dampens semantic scores and hard-caps the final score to prevent a COLD/fake lead from reaching HOT tier.

absolute_cold_overrides._comment: Hard-kill rules that force COLD tier regardless of all other scores. (1) NI override: fires when the intent gate falls below ni_hard_gate OR the query/message semantic similarity to not-interested anchors exceeds ni_sim_threshold OR lexical disinterest patterns match. (2) Prank budget: fires when a budget is explicitly provided but its absolute INR value is ≤ prank_budget_max_inr — clearly not a serious lead.

log_budget_duration._comment: Controls the log(budget_INR)/duration_months composite feature. Very low values indicate a financially implausible lead (e.g. ₹1K budget for a 6-month project). penalty_threshold: below this value a proportional point deduction is applied to the structured score. cold_threshold: below this the maximum penalty_points is applied. penalty_points: maximum points deducted (from structured score).

ollama._comment: Local Ollama LLM integration for complex linguistic intent disambiguation (e.g. 'we don't want X, we want Y').
